name: Quote generation - colored melamine
description: Customer requests a quote for colored melamine rather than white. AI should use generate_quote, return total and PDF link.

messages.text: My name is Test Customer, please give me a quote for 18 sheets of black melamine 16mm

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a quote total with R prefix
Quote should be generated (quote_total populated or PDF URL in reply)
Quote generation may take up to 30 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
No internal optimizer variable names in reply

notes: Tests quote generation for a colored melamine variant (black) rather than the standard white.
